list: the official 55 trophies, as listed 18 November 2026
note: Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them (Exophase and PSNProfiles agree on all 55). Guides are written in our own words for this entry; every guide names its sources. Launch-era methods were checked 18-19 November 2026 against the sources below.

vicecityhub.name: GTA VI Vice City Hub — Achievements

pressstart.name: Press-Start — 100% checklist figures (as reported by EGamers)

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — it has no requirement of its own, so the roadmap in this guide is the real guide to it: story first, then the 100% checklist, then cleanup. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 in difficulty at roughly 200 hours, with a single playthrough enough. On Xbox the same feat is the Mythic achievement, worth 0G because the other 54 add up to the full 1,000 Gamerscore.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game and cannot be missed — play the story and it pops at the end of the mission. Use this first hour to learn the controls rather than rushing: nothing in the opener is timed or graded.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1 of the story. Story trophies unlock in order as you play, so there is nothing special to do — but before Chapter 1 ends, meditate with Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house: that meditation may be needed for Positive Mental Attitude and is reported to disappear once the chapter closes. Make a manual save at the start of the chapter; the game has no mission replay.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it unlocks automatically at the end of the chapter. Most of the open-world trophy list opens up once both Jason and Lucia are playable, which happens from Chapter 2 onward, so this is a good point to start scanning vehicles and trying activities between missions.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Automatic at the end of the chapter. The robbery trophies begin to open up around Chapters 3 and 4, so keep an eye out for bank jobs and stick-up opportunities as the story moves into Vice City proper.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Automatic at the end of the chapter. The optional Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' is the gateway to the bank-vault robberies, so do not skip optional missions in this chapter — they feed Maximum Withdrawal later.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission — the story's ending, which some lists word as Chapter 5. It pops at the credits. Make a manual save before the final mission: there is no mission replay, and free-roam continues after the story, so the ending is also the moment the 100% checklist becomes visible under Progress > Stats.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. A story mission — play through it and the trophy pops at the end. Keep a manual save from the start of each chapter as you go: it is cheap insurance for the one missable meditation and the stranger chains.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. A story mission; it unlocks at the end of the heist. Heist missions are unreplayable, so enjoy the set piece — the trophy needs only completion, not a medal or a time.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Story mission, automatic on completion. There are no difficulty settings and no mission medals in GTA VI, so story trophies only ever ask that you finish the mission.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Story mission, automatic on completion. If you are following this guide's roadmap, you will earn it during the story playthrough in Stage 1.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. A story mission set at Vice City International Airport — automatic on completion. The airport also matters for Catch Me If You Can, which asks for an unscheduled departure from the same airfield.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Story mission, automatic on completion. Play the story in order and it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion — the hardest trophy in the set, and the last one most hunters earn. The checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion) only appears after the story, but progress made during the story already counts. It is lenient: PowerPyx puts it at roughly 60% of true completion — 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals, 50 of 66 weapons, 70 of 80 challenges — but a few lines need everything, including all 8 bank vaults, all 42 shooting-range golds and all 42 drone time trials. Nothing on the checklist is missable: it can all be finished in free-roam after the credits. See the 100% table in this guide for the trophy-vs-checklist targets.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida — jumps, under-bridge flights and more. Flying under bridges is reported to be the quickest kind to farm. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past the trophy: the extra 50 count toward A Long Road.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — fishing, arcade games, bowling, pool, mini golf, basketball, racing, drone racing and the shooting range are the kinds the list counts. One attempt at each is enough; you do not need to win or finish them. Sample an activity whenever you pass one during the story and this pops early.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. The range medals are reported to be forgiving, and the same 42 golds are required for 100%, so there is no extra work after the trophy. Practice with each weapon class before chasing golds — the challenges cover the range's full set.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations — 42 races in total across them. You only need one win per location for the trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 42 drone time trials, so expect to return. Learn each course's line before racing it for the win.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race counts once, so variety beats repetition. The 100% checklist wants 30 unique race wins, plus 10 race-challenge gold medals, so keep racing past the trophy. Pick a fast, stable car for each race type rather than forcing one favourite everywhere.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the 9 activity types, so this also feeds Master of None. Take the challenge when Cal offers it and watch the line tension — steady reeling beats yanking.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — play one of the arcade cabinets through to its end. Arcade games also count toward the 100% checklist's 'video games played' line (4 in total), so play more than one while you are there.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy — the end of his stranger mission strand. Start Andy's chain as soon as it unlocks: one guide warns the stranger chains have windows tied to story progress, so do not leave them until after the credits. Finish every mission in the strand and the trophy pops at the last one.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Same pattern as the other stranger strands: begin it when it unlocks and follow it to its last mission. Kenton also has 5 sets on the 100% checklist, so his strand pays twice.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy — the end of his stranger strand. Start it as soon as it appears and work through it alongside the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. The five named strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are five of the eight; find three more stranger givers around the state. Begin strands as soon as they unlock — one guide reports their windows are tied to story progress.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy — the end of his stranger strand. Start early, finish late: the strand's missions unlock across the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone — the end of his stranger strand. Begin it when it unlocks and follow it through.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations, with Jason and Lucia, according to GTABase. THIS IS THE ONE REPORTED MISSABLE TROPHY: the first meditation is Lucia's on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, and it is reported to disappear once Chapter 1 ends. Do it the moment it is offered and make a manual save first. Note the count is disputed: the 100% checklist lists 15 meditation spots, so the trophy and the checklist may count different things — meditate everywhere you find a spot.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Which animal the trophy wants is still unconfirmed at launch — no guide has pinned it down yet. Bret also has 15 target decks on the 100% checklist, so work his strand and check back once hunters report the animal. Studying animals in general feeds the checklist's 100 animals to observe.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; the 100% checklist wants all 15 sets, so keep collecting past the trophy. Clear one region at a time — sets complete faster when you finish an area before moving on.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations — use the WAiNK app to scan the world around you. The same 100 count toward 100%, and scanning also feeds Whip It Good (100 vehicles) and the 200 base-model vehicles the checklist wants, so scan everything, especially traffic on busy roads.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. The 100% checklist wants 70 of the 80 challenges, so the trophy is a milestone on the way — and you may skip the hardest 10 entirely. Work challenges alongside other goals rather than grinding them in one sitting.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build 4 stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and leave the red heat zone. Both launch guides point to a train tunnel north of Ambrosia as a good escape, and bank-vault robberies are a natural way to reach 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three in a row while still wanted — the jewelry stores of North Vice City sit close together, which helps. If the trophy does not pop after the third, GTABase says to rob a fourth.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. GTABase reports you only need to scan them with WAiNK — no need to drive them — and scanning traffic near busy roads is the efficient way. The 100% checklist wants 200 base-model vehicles scanned, so keep the scanner out.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Fill your Focus meter before you start, use an assault rifle, and aim for gang members — cops, soldiers and civilians are reported not to count. A gang hideout gives you grouped targets.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. GTABase reports the method: steal a docked passenger jet at Vice City International Airport and fly about 1 km away from it. Expect a wanted level — the escape is part of the fun.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description only hints: 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos.' GTABase reports the method: steal a tank (Rhino) from Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside it. A military base means heavy resistance — go in with a plan and a fast exit.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Open the store's back door with the Snap Gun, find the safe code and clear the safe without anyone spotting you. Move slowly, watch sight lines, and leave the way you came in.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. First complete the optional Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…', then follow a security van into a bank while its vault is open. Expect 4 stars on the way out and have a fast bike ready for the escape. The 100% checklist wants all 8 vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush a security truck on the road, take its cargo and lose the wanted level. A fast getaway vehicle parked nearby turns a hard trophy into an easy one.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas, clearing the fog from the map. Flying over the dark patches is reported to be the quickest way to clear them. Do it late, once you can fly: a few passes over the remaining fog finishes it.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. One per gang is enough for the trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 39 gang operations, so expect to hit every gang's turf several times over. Scout each operation before you rob it.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The unlock method is still unconfirmed at launch — PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known. The description points to a bar or venue with a view on Ocean Beach: order a cocktail there and see if it pops. Check back once hunters confirm the spot.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Still unconfirmed at launch — PowerPyx lists it as not yet known. GTABase thinks it involves crashing a car out through a showroom window, in the style of the classic GTA intro, but that is unconfirmed: try it, but do not be surprised if the real trigger differs.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Bowl a game at the named alley — the wording is a little unclear across sources, and one guide names a different alley, so if it does not pop at Kolt & Associates, try the other bowling venue. Bowling is also one of the 9 activity types.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description only hints: 'A partnership with mass appeal.' GTABase reports the method: max out the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. Train both characters — gym work, melee and heavy lifting all build Strength — and the trophy pops when the second one maxes out.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: The description only hints: 'Choices made (for better or worse).' GTABase links this trophy to the Criminal Profile: 500 actions that change your profile, tracked by PlayStation as a count to 500. That is a single-source report, so treat the number as reported, not confirmed — and note both guides say the Irredeemable profile rating is permanent, so read up on the Criminal Profile before going on a rampage.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The description only hints: 'Second time's the charm.' The unlock method is still unconfirmed at launch — PowerPyx lists it as not yet known. The name suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt; until hunters pin it down, keep playing and watch for it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The description only hints: 'What the hell just happened?' Still unconfirmed at launch — PowerPyx lists it as not yet known. GTABase thinks it refers to a strange event somewhere in Leonida, but that is unconfirmed. Explore odd corners of the map and keep an eye on hunter reports.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Still unconfirmed at launch — PowerPyx lists it as not yet known. The description suggests knocking people down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle; the exact trigger is unconfirmed, so treat the wording as a hint, not a method.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder through fences — GTABase reports one fence pays the most — and the total grows naturally during the 100% robberies. The same $250,000 is on the 100% checklist, so this trophy and the checklist finish together.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Every shop purchase counts — clothes, weapons, food, car mods. It adds up across the whole game, so do not grind it early; by the time you are buying garages and gear for other trophies, it will be close.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 of them, bought through the Vice City Real Estate app for around $160,000 in total. The 4 garages the story gives you do not count. Save your money for these rather than spending it on cars you can steal.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles worth keeping, register each in the app, and repeat until you reach 10. Vehicles you scan for Whip It Good are good candidates.
